name: how
purpose: Explain subsystem architecture and runtime flow for a senior engineer using inspected code.
inputs: Supplied execution path or subsystem scope
Available read-only worker and source tools
outputs: Overview, Key Concepts, How It Works, Where Things Live and Gotchas as applicable
Actual files and functions, data flow, boundaries, diagrams when useful and explicit open questions
ordinaryExample: Trace an API request from its route through its service calls and storage layer, citing the files read.
capabilityLimits: Absent workers require disclosed sequential exploration with reduced capability.
Model selection follows observed session support; source-host defaults are not portable.
Invocation metadata is preserved without claiming host enforcement.
Host behavior has not been tested.
